Lat/Long: 44.298775, -76.146896 (Approximated from archipelago)
Report Description2019/08/19 13:44 ONTARIO SPILL ACTION CENTER RECEIVED A CALL REPORTING GASOLINE COMING OUT FROM A PLEASURE CRAFT IN ST-LAURENCE RIVER / THOUSAND ISLANDS (ZAVIKON ISLAND). NO FURTHER INFORMATION PROVIDED. EED ACT 2019/08/19 AT 14H48. MD. UPDATE 1 RECEIVED FROM ONTARIO SPILL ACTION CENTER (REPORT #2751-BF7NHA) AT NEEC NOTIFICATIONS DESK 2019/08/19 AT 14H47. JC. CALLER STATED HE HAS BEEN WORKING WITH THE LEEDS AND THOUSAND ISLANDS TOWNSHIP REGARDING AN OLD BOAT HOUSE THAT HAS BEEN FALLING APART. THE BOATHOUSE HAS TWO ANTIQUE PLEASURE CRAFT IN IT (1930S) AND ONE OF THEM IS LEAKING GASOLINE. CALLER STATED THE MAXIMUM CAPACITY OF THE TANK WOULD BE APPROXIMATELY 80 L. CALLER STATED THE BOATS HAVE NOT BEEN IN THE WATER FOR CLOSE TO 40 YEARS. CALLER STATED HE HAS NOTIFIED THE TOWNSHIP AND THEY ARE RESPONDING. SAC INQUIRED IF THE CALLER HAS ANY ABSORBENT BOOMS THAT CAN BE USED TO CONTAIN THE AREA; CALLER STATED HE DOES AND HE WILL. CALLER COULD NOT ESTIMATE HOW MUCH HAS LEAKED. CALLER STATED IN THE AREA THE WATER IS MORE CALM. 13:43 - SACKM TO CCG - BRIEFED ON THE DETAILS. CALLER STATED HE WILL CONTACT THE ORIGINAL CALLER FOR FOLLOW UP

properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 963087

Nearest City: Grosse Ile, MI
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: UNKNOWN OIL
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: COMPEAU BROS. EXCAVATING
Skytruth Analysis
*WEB REPORT* ON THE NIGHT OF DEC 22, I WAS RETURNING HOME. I PULLED INTO MY GARAGE AND CLOSED THE DOOR. THE NEXT MORNING I WENT INTO THE GARAGE AND NOTICED THE HEAVY SMELL OF DIESEL OIL. AFTER LEAVING MY GARAGE WITH THE CAR I NOTICED A LARGE CIRCLE IN THE SNOW , I GOT OUT TO INVESTIGATE AND FOUND THE REASON FOR MY GARAGE SMELLING OF DIESEL FUEL. THERE WAS A CIRCLE ABOUT 50 FEET IN DIAMETER. IN THE SNOW. THIS AREA IS A SIDE DRIVE EASMENT FOR WILBER ROAD. THERE WAS NO WAY TO GET AROUND THE OIL SPILL. I CONTINUED ON TO THE GROSSE ILE TOWNSHIP DPW, BUT THEY WERE CLOSED FOR CHRISTMAS, I THEN WENT TO THE NEARBY EPA OFFICE LOCATED ON GROSSE ILE AIRPORT GROUNDS. THEY SAID THEY WOULD TRY AND CONTACT THE EXCAVATING COMPANY. I PROCEED TO GO TO THE GROSSE ILE POLICE DEPARTMENT TO EXPLAIN WHAT HAD HAPPENED, THEY SAID THEY WOULD CONTACT THE EXCAVATING COMPANY. AFTER ARRIVING HOME I SAW A MAN WITH A BACK HOE SCRAPPING UP THE OILY SNOW AND PUTTING DOWN KITTY LITTER TO TRY AND ABSORB THE OIL THAT WAS STILL ON THE ASPHALT ROAD, I AM AFRAID THAT IF WE HAVE A QUICK MELT LIKE THEY ARE PREDICTING FOR DEC 30 THAT THE REMAINING OIL WILL DRAIN INTO THE DITCH WHICH DRAINS INTO FRENCHMAN CREEK [ABOUT 100 FEET AWAY] AND OUT TO LAKE ERIE.
